udt_error_enum_v0.doc:
Error ranges reserved by dependencies.

| Range                    | Owner                       | Status                     |
|--------------------------|-----------------------------|----------------------------|
| `1..=15`                 | Stellar Asset Contract      | live \xe2\x80\x94 runtime (SAC calls) |
| `100..=114`              | OZ `FungibleTokenError`     | live \xe2\x80\x94 in wasm (LP token)  |
| `200..=211`, `300..=34x` | OZ non-fungible / RWA       | compiled, not in wasm      |
| `1000..=1501`            | OZ `stellar-contract-utils` | compiled, not in wasm      |
| `2000..=2202`            | OZ `stellar-access`         | not linked                 |
| `4000..=5012`            | OZ governance               | compiled, not in wasm      |

| Band     | Range       | What                               | Retriable                    | Fires normally |
|----------|-------------|------------------------------------|------------------------------|----------------|
| Input    | `x000\xe2\x80\x93x099` | Malformed input
udt_error_enum_v0.name: Error

cases.doc: A coin count \xe2\x80\x94 the constructor's token count, or a per-coin vector's length \xe2\x80\x94 is not exactly\nthe pool's compile-time `COINS`.
cases.name: InputCoinCountOutOfRange

cases.doc: Coin index is not in `0..COINS`.
cases.name: InputCoinIndexOutOfRange

cases.doc: A swap needs two different coins.
cases.name: InputDuplicateCoinIndex

cases.doc: `amounts` length does not equal the coin count.
cases.name: InputAmountsLengthMismatch

cases.doc: The input amount is zero (vs `MarketLpRoundsToZero`, which is nonzero but too small).
cases.name: InputZeroAmount

cases.doc: A negative amount; the engine's arithmetic is unsigned.
cases.name: InputNegativeAmount

cases.doc: `fee` is outside `0..=MAX_FEE`.
cases.name: InputFeeOutOfRange

cases.doc: `admin_fee` exceeds `FEE_DENOMINATOR`.
cases.name: InputAdminFeeOutOfRange

cases.doc: `offpeg_fee_multiplier` below `FEE_DENOMINATOR`, or the dynamic fee it implies exceeds `MAX_FEE`.
cases.name: InputOffpegMultiplierOutOfRange

cases.doc: `A` is outside `1..MAX_A`.
cases.name: InputAmpOutOfRange

cases.doc: A ramp must run at least `MIN_RAMP_TIME`.
cases.name: InputRampDurationTooShort

cases.doc: A coin reports more decimals than `PRECISION_DECIMALS`.
cases.name: InputTooManyDecimals

cases.doc: The entrypoint or option is not implemented in this port.
cases.name: InputNotImplemented

cases.doc: Caller is not the Factory's admin.
cases.name: PolicyNotFactoryAdmin

cases.doc: Called before the constructor ran.
cases.name: StateNotInitialized

cases.doc: The operation needs liquidity, and the LP supply is zero.
cases.name: StateLpSupplyEmpty

cases.doc: A reserve is zero; the invariant is undefined there.
cases.name: StateReserveEmpty

cases.doc: A ramp was requested before `MIN_RAMP_TIME` elapsed since the last one.
cases.name: StateRampTooSoon

cases.doc: The ramp would move `A` by more than `MAX_A_CHANGE`\xc3\x97 from its current value.
cases.name: StateAmpChangeTooLarge

cases.doc: The caller would get less, or pay more, than the bound they set.
cases.name: MarketSlippageExceeded

cases.doc: A real input too small to mint or burn any LP; a larger one may succeed.
cases.name: MarketLpRoundsToZero

cases.doc: The LP burn exceeds total supply \xe2\x80\x94 a claim on more than the pool holds.
cases.name: MarketBurnExceedsSupply

cases.doc: The burner does not hold the LP being burned (vs `MarketBurnExceedsSupply`, the whole pool).
cases.name: MarketInsufficientLpBalance

cases.doc: Tokens received fall short of the claimed `dx` (`exchange_received` only).
cases.name: MarketReceivedShortfall

cases.doc: The requested output or withdrawal exceeds what the coin reserve can pay; retry with less.
cases.name: MarketInsufficientLiquidity

cases.doc: A coin's token rejected a transfer *into* the pool (payer's balance/allowance/trustline).
cases.name: ExtTokenPullFailed

cases.doc: A coin's token rejected a transfer *out of* the pool. Not the caller's fault; escalate.
cases.name: ExtTokenPushFailed

cases.doc: A coin's token trapped or returned a value we could not interpret.
cases.name: ExtTokenPanicked

cases.doc: A coin's token would not report usable `decimals`.
cases.name: ExtTokenBadMetadata

cases.doc: The bound Factory could not be reached to resolve admin / fee receiver.
cases.name: ExtFactoryUnavailable

cases.doc: Newton iteration did not converge inside its cap; retry smaller.
cases.name: MathNotConverged

cases.doc: Checked arithmetic failed \xe2\x80\x94 overflow, or unsigned underflow (e.g. withdrawing past a reserve).
cases.name: MathArithmetic

cases.doc: A postcondition this contract guarantees did not hold. (Not `InvariantViolated`: "the\ninvariant" here means the curve's `D`.)
cases.name: InternalBug

cases.doc: Stored reserves disagree with the stored coin count.
cases.name: InternalReservesMalformed

cases.doc: The engine rejected the pool's own stored params (fee, `A`, admin fee, or rate).
cases.name: InternalStoredParamsInvalid

cases.doc: The LP token's `total_supply` diverged from the engine's `lp_supply`.
cases.name: InternalLpSupplyDrift

cases.doc: An engine value did not fit a host `i128`.
cases.name: InternalValueUnrepresentable

udt_struct_v0.doc: Pool configuration. Curve scalars are stored as `i128` and lifted to `Word` in `state.rs`.
udt_struct_v0.name: Config

fields.doc: The Factory that deployed this pool. **Write-once**: no entrypoint re-points a live pool\n(N-05). The pool holds no admin of its own \xe2\x80\x94 it resolves authority from this Factory on every\ngated call (F-07), so a Factory admin rotation takes effect here immediately.
fields.name: factory

fields.doc: Amplification ramp endpoints, both pre-scaled `A * A_PRECISION`. Together with\n`initial_a_time`/`future_a_time` they define a linear `A(t)` (see `amp::current_a`); a static\npool keeps the endpoints equal so `A(t)` is constant.
fields.name: initial_a

fields.doc: Ledger timestamps bounding the ramp, in seconds.
fields.name: initial_a_time

fields.doc: SAC addresses, one per coin (`len == n_coins`).
fields.name: tokens

udt_struct_v0.doc: Mutable pool reserves.\n`balances` are the active pool reserves; `admin_balances` the protocol's cut.
udt_struct_v0.name: Reserves

function_v0.name: a

function_v0.doc: Base swap fee over `FEE_DENOMINATOR`.
function_v0.name: fee

function_v0.doc: SAC address of coin `i`.\n\n- `i`: index of the coin.
function_v0.name: coins

function_v0.doc: Instantaneous price of coin `i` against coin 0, computed from the current balances.\n\n- `i`: index of the coin to price.
function_v0.name: get_p

function_v0.doc: Pool config: tokens, curve params, and per-coin rates.
function_v0.name: config

function_v0.doc:
Quote the amount of coin `i` required to receive `dy` of coin `j` \xe2\x80\x94 the inverse of
[`Self::get_dy`], fee taken into account.

- `i`: index of the coin being sold (input).
- `j`: index of the coin being bought (output).
- `dy`: desired amount of coin `j` to receive after the swap fee is deducted.
function_v0.name: get_dx

function_v0.doc:
Quote the amount of coin `j` received for `dx` of coin `i`, net of the swap fee.

- `i`: index of the coin being sold (input).
- `j`: index of the coin being bought (output).
- `dx`: amount of coin `i` paid in.
function_v0.name: get_dy

function_v0.doc:
Begin linearly ramping the amplification `A` to `future_a` by ledger time `future_time`.

See `amp::ramp` for the timing and change bounds a ramp must satisfy.

- `caller`: authorizes the call; must be the Factory's admin.
- `future_a`: human amplification to ramp to, NOT pre-scaled by `A_PRECISION`.
- `future_time`: ledger timestamp (seconds) at which the ramp completes.
function_v0.name: ramp_a

function_v0.doc: The Factory this pool is permanently bound to.
function_v0.name: factory

function_v0.doc: Active reserve of coin `i`.\n\n- `i`: index of the coin.
function_v0.name: balances

function_v0.doc: Moving-average oracle of the invariant `D`, read at the current ledger time.
function_v0.name: d_oracle

function_v0.doc:
Swap `dx` of coin `i` into coin `j`, returning the `dy` paid out net of the swap fee.

- `caller`: authorizes the call and pays `dx` in.
- `i`: index of the coin being sold (input).
- `j`: index of the coin being bought (output).
- `dx`: amount of coin `i` paid in.
- `min_dy`: slippage floor on the coins out.
- `receiver`: paid the `dy` out.
function_v0.name: exchange

function_v0.doc: Active + admin reserves, per coin.
function_v0.name: reserves

function_v0.doc: Current amplification scaled by `A_PRECISION`.
function_v0.name: a_precise

function_v0.doc: Admin's share of the fee over `FEE_DENOMINATOR`.
function_v0.name: admin_fee

function_v0.doc: EMA (moving-average) price of coin `i` against coin 0.\n\n- `i`: index of the coin to price.
function_v0.name: ema_price

function_v0.doc: Spot price of coin `i` against coin 0, as of the last trade.\n\n- `i`: index of the coin to price.
function_v0.name: last_price

function_v0.doc:
Dynamic (off-peg) fee for the `i \xe2\x86\x92 j` direction, scaled by `FEE_DENOMINATOR`.

Rises from the base fee towards `fee * offpeg_fee_multiplier` as the two coins drift apart.

- `i`: index of the coin being sold (input).
- `j`: index of the coin being bought (output).
function_v0.name: dynamic_fee

function_v0.doc:
Set the base swap fee and the off-peg fee multiplier.

The three bounds below are the whole validation: they are strictly tighter than anything
`Pool::new` would reject on these two fields, and every *other* field of `PoolParams` is
immutable here \xe2\x80\x94 validated where it was written ([`Self::__constructor`], [`Self::ramp_a`]).
Re-running the engine's validation would therefore reject nothing a caller could reach.

- `caller`: authorizes the call; must be the Factory's admin.
- `new_fee`: base swap fee, scaled by `FEE_DENOMINATOR`; at most `MAX_FEE` (50%).
- `new_offpeg_fee_multiplier`: off-peg fee multiplier, scaled by `FEE_DENOMINATOR`; at least
1.0x, and small enough that the dynamic fee it implies stays under `MAX_FEE`.
function_v0.name: set_new_fee

function_v0.doc: Halt an in-progress `A` ramp, pinning `A` at its current value.\n\n- `caller`: authorizes the call; must be the Factory's admin.
function_v0.name: stop_ramp_a

function_v0.doc: All active reserves.
function_v0.name: get_balances

function_v0.doc: Moving-average price oracle for coin `i`, read at the current ledger time.\n\n- `i`: index of the coin to price.
function_v0.name: price_oracle

function_v0.doc: Per-coin rate multipliers bridging native decimals to `xp`.
function_v0.name: stored_rates

function_v0.doc:
Setup the pool and register the contract as its own SEP-41 LP token.

- `factory`: Factory this pool is permanently bound to; admin and fee receiver are resolved
from it on every gated call.
- `tokens`: SAC address of every coin, each with at most `PRECISION_DECIMALS` decimals.
- `name`: name of the LP token.
- `symbol`: symbol of the LP token.
- `amplification`: initial `A`, pre-scaled by `A_PRECISION`.
- `fee`: base swap fee, scaled by `FEE_DENOMINATOR`.
- `admin_fee`: protocol's share of `fee`, scaled by `FEE_DENOMINATOR`.
- `offpeg_fee_multiplier`: off-peg fee multiplier, scaled by `FEE_DENOMINATOR`; must be at least 1.0x.
function_v0.name: __constructor

function_v0.doc:
Deposit `amounts`, returning the LP minted.

On the first deposit every coin must be nonzero and the LP minted is the invariant `D`
itself; later deposits are charged the imbalance fee on the part of the deposit that shifts
the pool away from its current balance.

- `caller`: authorizes the call and pays the coins in.
- `amounts`: amount of each coin to deposit, one entry per coin.
- `min_mint`: slippage floor on the LP minted.
- `receiver`: credited the minted LP.
function_v0.name: add_liquidity

function_v0.doc:
Accumulated admin balance of coin `i` \xe2\x80\x94 the protocol's uncollected fee cut, held outside the
active reserves until [`Self::withdraw_admin_fees`] collects it.

- `i`: index of the coin.
function_v0.name: admin_balances

function_v0.doc:
Set the moving-average windows of the price and `D` oracles. Not implemented: this port keeps
no moving-average state.

- `caller`: authorizes the call; must be the Factory's admin.
- `ma_exp_time`: window of the price oracle, in seconds.
- `d_ma_time`: window of the invariant-`D` oracle, in seconds.
function_v0.name: set_ma_exp_time

function_v0.doc:
Burn LP for a proportional, fee-free payout of every coin, returning the amounts paid out.

Pays out the same fraction \xe2\x80\x94 `burn_amount / lp_supply` \xe2\x80\x94 of every coin, so the pool's mix is
unchanged by the withdrawal. Nothing is charged.

- `caller`: authorizes the call and is charged the LP burn.
- `burn_amount`: LP-token amount being redeemed.
- `min_amounts`: slippage floor for each coin, one entry per coin.
- `receiver`: paid the coins.
- `claim_admin_fees`: must be `false`; `true` errors with [`Error::InputNotImplemented`], as the
bundled admin-fee sweep is not shipped.
function_v0.name: remove_liquidity

function_v0.doc:
Quote the LP minted (deposit) or burned (withdrawal) for a balance change, imbalance fee
taken into account.

- `amounts`: amount added or removed for each coin, one entry per coin.
- `is_deposit`: `true` to add `amounts`, `false` to remove them.
function_v0.name: calc_token_amount

function_v0.doc:
Swap coin `i` into coin `j` against tokens already sent to the pool, returning the `dy` paid
out net of the swap fee.

Like [`Self::exchange`], except the pool credits the input from the increase in its own
coin-`i` balance \xe2\x80\x94 tokens transferred in beforehand \xe2\x80\x94 rather than pulling them from `caller`.

- `caller`: authorizes the call; pays nothing here, having already sent the coins.
- `i`: index of the coin being sold (input).
- `j`: index of the coin being bought (output).
- `dx`: amount of coin `i` claimed to have been sent in; the measured increase must cover it.
- `min_dy`: slippage floor on the coins out.
- `receiver`: paid the `dy` out.
function_v0.name: exchange_received

function_v0.doc: Invariant `D` per unit of LP supply, as fixed point scaled by `precision()`.
function_v0.name: get_virtual_price

function_v0.doc: Withdraw accumulated `admin_balances` out to the Factory's fee receiver.\n\nPermissionless, anyone may trigger withdrawal.
function_v0.name: withdraw_admin_fees

function_v0.doc: Off-peg fee multiplier over `FEE_DENOMINATOR`.
function_v0.name: offpeg_fee_multiplier

function_v0.doc:
Quote the amount of coin `i` received for burning `burn_amount` LP in a one-coin withdrawal,
withdrawal fee taken into account.

- `burn_amount`: LP-token amount being redeemed.
- `i`: index of the coin to withdraw.
function_v0.name: calc_withdraw_one_coin

function_v0.doc:
Withdraw a single coin `i` by burning LP, returning the coin amount paid out.

The burn shrinks the invariant pro-rata; the payout is the resulting drop in coin `i`,
reduced by the single-coin withdrawal fee.

- `caller`: authorizes the call and is charged the LP burn.
- `burn_amount`: LP-token amount being redeemed.
- `i`: index of the coin to withdraw.
- `min_received`: slippage floor on the coins out.
- `receiver`: paid the coins.
function_v0.name: remove_liquidity_one_coin

function_v0.doc:
Withdraw an explicit, possibly imbalanced `amounts`, returning the LP actually burned.

The part of the withdrawal that shifts the pool away from its current balance is charged the
imbalance fee, so an imbalanced exit burns more LP than a balanced one of the same value.

- `caller`: authorizes the call and is charged the LP burn.
- `amounts`: amount of each coin to withdraw, one entry per coin.
- `max_burn`: slippage cap on the LP burned.
- `receiver`: paid the coins.
function_v0.name: remove_liquidity_imbalance

event_v0.doc: Event emitted when tokens are burned.
event_v0.name: Burn

event_v0.name: Mint

event_v0.doc: Event emitted when an allowance is approved.
event_v0.name: Approve

event_v0.doc:
Event emitted when tokens are transferred between addresses without a
muxed destination.

Per SEP-41, the event data is a bare `i128` when no muxed address is
involved. The `data_format = "single-value"` attribute ensures the
`amount` field is serialized as a bare value rather than a map.
event_v0.name: Transfer

event_v0.doc:
Event emitted when tokens are transferred to a muxed address.

Per SEP-41, when the destination is a [`MuxedAddress`] the event data
carries both the amount and the muxed identifier so that off-chain
consumers can attribute the transfer to the correct sub-account.

Uses `topics = ["transfer"]` so that both [`Transfer`] and
[`MuxedTransfer`] share the same `"transfer"` event symbol, as required
by SEP-41.
event_v0.name: MuxedTransfer
